Title: Apply coupon
Steps: Add item to cart; apply coupon; proceed to checkout

Title: Use loyalty points
Steps: Add item to cart; apply loyalty points; proceed to checkout
Expected Result: Points are deducted and discount is applied

Title: Coupon and points cannot be combined
Preconditions: User has a valid coupon and loyalty points
Steps: Add item to cart; apply coupon; attempt to apply points
Expected Result: Points cannot be applied while coupon is active

Title: Checkout without discount
Preconditions: User has an item in cart
Steps: Proceed to checkout without applying coupon or points

Title: Invalid coupon
Steps: Add item to cart; apply expired coupon
Expected Result: Coupon is rejected with an error message
